verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Data Access API (OpenAPI 3.0.3) for reading errors, projects and organization data 'to build custom integrations', plus webhook data forwarding. These are developer building blocks for constructing an export, not a documented export-all or data-portability feature. The community script that dumps exceptions is a user-side workaround, so no first-party bulk export in open formats is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
